## Verification

- [ ] `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] `npm run test`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] `npm run aimix:selftest` if the change affects AIMIX, reference analysis, spatial processing, or mastering
- [ ] Manual browser/audio checks where relevant

## Audio / mobile impact

Describe any effect on loudness, tone, stereo image, artifacts, CPU, memory, Safari/PWA behavior, or offline rendering. Write `None` if not applicable.

## Security / privacy / licensing

- [ ] No credentials, private audio, local backups, or build archives are included.
- [ ] New dependencies/assets have clear provenance and compatible licensing.
- [ ] Any remote upload, API call, analytics, model, WASM DSP, or binary dependency is explicitly documented.

## AI assistance

If AI coding tools materially contributed to the change, note how their output was reviewed and verified. The submitter remains responsible for the final code and provenance.
